metadata.description: Structured technology taxonomy: domains, subdomains, principles, processes, components, systems, industries, cemetery, candidates. Three relationship classes: structural, functional, historical.

nodes.label: Electronics
nodes.description: Study of electron flow and circuits

nodes.label: Segway
nodes.description: Personal transportation device that never achieved mass adoption

metadata.why_it_failed: Price too high, infrastructure not ready, regulatory uncertainty, social stigma
assumptions_that_broke: Assumed cities would redesign for personal vehicles
metadata.lesson: Technology alone cannot overcome infrastructure and social constraints

metadata.why_it_failed: Social rejection, privacy concerns, limited use case, high price
metadata.lesson: Consumer AR requires social acceptance before technical capability

metadata.why_it_failed: Fuel costs, noise restrictions, limited routes, high prices, 2000 crash
assumptions_that_broke: Assumed sonic boom restrictions would relax
metadata.lesson: Economic and environmental constraints can ground technically brilliant designs

nodes.label: Theranos
nodes.description: Blood testing from single finger prick

metadata.why_it_failed: Technology never worked as claimed. Fraud, not engineering failure.
assumptions_that_broke: Assumed microfluidics could replace lab analysis
metadata.lesson: Fraud poisons legitimate technology lines. The underlying idea is valid.

metadata.why_it_failed: Wrong timing, no social sharing, unclear value vs free alternatives
assumptions_that_broke: Assumed people pay for short content
metadata.lesson: Content format innovation requires matching distribution and business model innovation

metadata.why_it_failed: Handsets too large/expensive, terrestrial cellular expanded faster, bankruptcy
assumptions_that_broke: Assumed global coverage premium justifies cost
Assumed business travelers need satellite phones
metadata.lesson: Infrastructure bets can be right but early. Iridium satellites now serve IoT and military.

metadata.why_it_failed: Lost format war to VHS. Shorter recording time, less licensing, smaller ecosystem.
assumptions_that_broke: Assumed technical superiority wins format wars
metadata.lesson: Ecosystem and openness beat technical superiority in format competition

metadata.why_it_failed: Lost format war to Blu-ray. Studio support, PS3 bundling, retail decisions.
metadata.lesson: Platform bundling and content partnerships outweigh technical specifications

nodes.label: Airships
nodes.description: Rigid dirigible airships for passenger and cargo transport

metadata.why_it_failed: Hindenburg disaster, helium shortage, airplane speed advantage, weather vulnerability
resurrection_conditions: Heavy-lift cargo demand to remote areas
metadata.lesson: Catastrophic failure can end a technology line for decades, but constraint changes can reopen it
